canonical.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Maison Colette

parent.title: A Maison Colette weekend in Tongerlo

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Maison Colette
siblings.summary: Maison Colette's own 5-room guesthouse is the obvious answer; otherwise three B&Bs and one 4-star hotel sit within a 14–26 min walk of De Trannoyplein 17.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Maison Colette
siblings.summary: Where to sleep within a 20-minute taxi of Maison Colette — from the restaurant's own 5 dinner-bundled rooms to a 17th-century watermill, a former Carmelite convent, and a forester's house in the woods.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Maison Colette
siblings.summary: Leuven and Mechelen meetups sit inside 30 km of Tongerlo; the headliner Antwerp conferences (Techorama, Devoxx, DDD Europe, BC TechDays) sit 35-47 km out but are still <50 min by car.

sources.title: Tongerlo Abbey — official site (EN)
sources.claim: Mon–Sat 08:00–11:00 & 13:00–17:00, Sun 08:00–10:00 & 13:00–17:00. Free entry. 5-min push-button light in the side aisle.

sources.title: Is there a real Da Vinci in Westerlo? — Toerisme Westerlo
sources.claim: 8×4 m canvas painted 1507–08 in Milan; multispectral analysis attributes the sfumato and St. John's face to Leonardo himself.

sources.title: Abdij van Tongerlo — Toerisme Westerlo
sources.claim: The Da Vinci Museum closed 1 Nov 2021 for restoration; since summer 2025 the canvas hangs back in the abbey church.

sources.title: Kasteel Prins de Merode — Toerisme Westerlo
sources.claim: Private residence of Prince Simon de Merode, normally closed; opens for Kerstmagie (Dec) and biennial Historalia in summer.

sources.title: Castle of Westerlo — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 12 ha English park around the castle, 60 ha French formal park across the Nete — combination called unique in Belgium.

sources.title: Kasteelfeesten van Westerlo — NNieuws
sources.claim: Kasteelfeesten open the private castle on the first weekend of July; €8, free under-14.

sources.title: Kerstmagie — Kasteel van Westerlo
sources.claim: Costumed-character December evening tour through the castle.

sources.title: Wandelnetwerk de Merode — Bezoek de Merode
sources.claim: ~700 km of waymarked walking paths across three provinces; billed the most popular walking area in Flanders.

sources.title: Averbode Bos en Heide — Natuurpunt
sources.claim: Blue 4.3 km / 60 min, red 11.2 km / 170 min loops from Abdijstraat 1, Averbode.

sources.title: Averbode Bos en Heide — Bezoek de Merode
sources.claim: Natuurpunt manages 593 ha within a 1,500+ ha cross-province complex bought in 2004 from the de Merode family.

sources.title: LIFE habitat restoration in Averbode Bos en Heide — EU LIFE
sources.claim: 2006–12 restored 58 ha heath, 10+ ha open dunes, 21 ha Nardus grassland; nightjar returned as breeding bird.

sources.title: Abdij Averbode — official site
sources.claim: 1134 Premonstratensian abbey; 55 canons in residence; freely visitable mornings till 11:30 and afternoons from 14:00.

sources.title: De Beeltjens — Toerisme Westerlo
sources.claim: 127 ha star-avenue forest, 24 m dune Asberg, Westerlo's backyard.

sources.title: Kempen fietsnetwerk — Toerisme Kempen
sources.claim: 2,000+ km signposted cycling network; refreshed provincial map rolling out end of March 2026.

sources.title: Postel walk — Visit Mol
sources.claim: Abdij Postel ~35–40 km north-east of Westerlo; five waymarked 3–12 km walks from the abbey gate.

sources.title: Hertog Jan — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Dutch brewery in Arcen, owned by AB InBev since 1995 — not Belgian Kempen.

sources.title: Duvel Moortgat — brewery visit
sources.claim: Puurs-Sint-Amands site; Saturday tours 11:00 / 14:00, €18; ~44 km from Westerlo (outside the ring).

sources.title: Brouwerij Haacht — brewery visit
sources.claim: Mon–Thu tours for groups 15–50, €19 pp; Boortmeerbeek ~35 km from Westerlo (outside the ring); brews Tongerlo abbey beer.

sources.title: Zimmertoren — official site (EN)
sources.claim: Louis Zimmer's astronomical Centenary Clock and Astronomical Studio in Lier.

sources.title: Begijnhof Lier — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Founded 1258; 11 streets, 162 houses; UNESCO World Heritage 1998.

sources.title: Liers Vlaaike — Visit Lier
sources.claim: 300-year-old spiced regional pastry; Flemish regional product 2007, EU recognised 2013.

sources.title: Stedelijk Museum Wuyts-Van Campen — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Closed since February 2018 — don't plan it.

sources.title: Sint-Sulpitiuskerk Diest — Flemish Masters in Situ
sources.claim: 1320–1537; holds the tomb of Philip William of Orange-Nassau.

sources.title: Begijnhof Diest — Toerisme Vlaams-Brabant
sources.claim: Groot Begijnhof founded 1253, UNESCO-listed, among the largest beguinages in the world.

sources.title: Things to do in Diest — Bhushavali travel guide
sources.claim: Diest citadel (1845–53) — one of few European citadels with defence system intact.

sources.title: National Museum of the Playing Card — Atlas Obscura
sources.claim: Turnhout produced 1.3M packs/day; antique printing machines on display.

sources.title: Geel — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Sint-Dimpnakerk + medieval-rooted family-foster-care psychiatry; close to 500 patients still placed with townspeople today.

sources.title: Gasthuismuseum Geel — In Dimpna's footsteps
sources.claim: Former infirmary attached to Sint-Dimpnakerk; medieval pilgrim care evolved into modern foster-family psychiatric model.

sources.title: Bobbejaanland — opening hours & prices
sources.claim: €28.90 with code OPEN26 (reg. €49.90); Land of Legends, Adventure Valley themed areas.

sources.title: Typhoon (Bobbejaanland) — Coasterpedia
sources.claim: Gerstlauer Euro-Fighter: 97° vertical drop, loop, double heartline roll, 540° helix; opened 10 April 2004.

sources.title: Fury (Bobbejaanland) — Coasterpedia
sources.claim: Gerstlauer triple-launch, 43 m tall, 106.6 km/h; opened 24 June 2019; riders vote forwards or backwards.

sources.title: Zilvermeer — Provincie Antwerpen
sources.claim: Sand-beach swim pond + go-carts, mini-golf, rowing, water bikes; sailing/surf/kayak by group reservation.

sources.title: Hiking in the Sahara — Visit Lommel
sources.claim: Blue 3.8 km family, orange 5.7, red 11.7 km (voted Belgium's most beautiful hike); no swimming.

sources.title: Sunparks Kempense Meren — official
sources.claim: Aquafun wave pool, rapids, Black Hole dark slide; Kids World indoor.

sources.title: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt — official
sources.claim: 25+ attractions, Wickie Coaster; dated €24 / undated €32; family €25 pp.

sources.title: Prinsenpark Retie — official
sources.claim: 215 ha free-access; speelbos with camp-building, toddler areas, ponds, viewing huts.

sources.title: Kabouterberg Kasterlee — official
sources.claim: Sand hills, climbing, maze; 1.5 km gnome-themed trail, ages 3–7.

sources.title: Goodwill Karting Olen — official (EN)
sources.claim: 600 m indoor/outdoor track with banked turn; €13 / 12 min.

sources.title: BattleKart Herentals — official
sources.claim: Electric karts with projected interactive landscape; min height 1.45 m.

sources.title: Padel Club 360 Westerlo — official
sources.claim: 5 outdoor courts in-village.

sources.title: Averbode Beer — visit our brewery
sources.claim: Bottles brewed at Huyghe in Melle; draught house beer brewed inside the abbey café, only tastable on site.

sources.title: Het Moment — Abbey Shop
sources.claim: Abbey café with in-house micro-brewery, cheese factory, bakery and abbey shop.

sources.title: Trappist Westmalle — official
sources.claim: Abbey + brewery not open to general public except one annual open day.

sources.title: Café Trappisten Malle — hours
sources.claim: Open Mon–Sun 10:00–24:00; Extra/Dubbel/Tripel + abbey cheese; seats 1,200 with terrace opposite the brewery gate.

sources.title: Brouwerij Pirlot Zandhoven — location
sources.claim: Group ≥15 by appointment; €10 pp tour + 3 tastings.

sources.title: Brouwerij Leysen — Streketour stop 25 May 2026
sources.claim: Baskwadder range; Thu 18:00–21:00 + weekend by appointment; Streketour stop Sun 25 May 2026.

sources.title: Lier Saturday market — Visit Lier
sources.claim: Every Saturday 08:00–12:30 on and around the Grote Markt.

sources.title: Westerlo wekelijkse marktdag — gemeente Westerlo
sources.claim: Westerlo's own weekly market runs Wednesday only.

sources.title: Chocolaterie Lornoy Herentals — Gault&Millau
sources.claim: Melocakes in 20 flavours, pralines, paardenkoppen.

sources.title: Abdijproducten — Tongerlo Abbey
sources.claim: Shop 'De Oude Linden' sells Tongerlo beer, honey, jams, liqueurs; no tasting on site.
